source_and_access: Primary source remains [City Record Online](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/dg92-zbpx) notice title/body and agency fields. Capital subsets may use [Capital Projects Dashboard](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/fb86-vt7u) community district/project metadata. No verified general-purpose “place served by contract” dataset exists.
join_feasibility: **Measured:** 128/340 Money rows located (37.6%); 212/340 remain `no_place_signal` on 2026-08-04. A separate response-logistics join found usable action addresses on 26/40 current solicitation rows and resolved all 30 extracted addresses; 15 of those rows overlap this residual, so 197 rows lack either kind of geography. Submission offices and pre-bid venues are explicitly not performance evidence, so the performance residual remains 212 ([receipt](evidence/contracts-action-address-geo/join_receipt.json)).
reader_value: **5** — Map and Money; residents can answer “what spending affects my district?” while vendors can separately find where to submit or attend.
disposition: The basis-labeled response-location layer landed. Performance geography remains high value but blocked for universal coverage; next split that residual by procurement class and agency.
